DEFINITION · qeva:1:limit@1

Limit

A limit states that values eventually remain arbitrarily close to a target.

editorialanalysis · topology
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

A limit states that values eventually remain arbitrarily close to a target.

EXACT

The compact statement

In a metric space, xₙ→L iff for every ε>0 there exists N such that n≥N implies d(xₙ,L)<ε.

Example

The sequence 1/n converges to 0 in ℝ.

Boundary / caveat

Limits depend on the ambient topology and on the indexing notion.

Assumptions

  • The declared metric or topological spaces context is fixed.
